Know OET in Brief

OET is actually an International English Language Proficiency test like IELTS or TOEFL. But OET is specifically designed for those in healthcare sector. Moreover, it is an internationally recognized test. It will test a candidate’s ability to communicate in a healthcare sector in an English speaking country. Like IELTS, OET also have four language skills – Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing.

What is the Scope of OET?

OET is used to test the English speaking skills of people who wish to work in healthcare sector. By giving advanced coaching for OET with leading trainers, Casper Academy of Excellence is the leading name for OET coaching in Kochi. Here are the healthcare professions that OET caters:

  • Medicine
  • Nursing
  • Dietetics
  • Dentistry
  • Occupational Therapy
  • Pharmacy
  • Physiotherapy
  • Optometry
  • Podiatry
  • Speech Pathology
  • Radiography
  • Veterinary Science

Why Get a Good Score in OET?

As we have already discussed, OET is specifically developed for healthcare professionals. Thus, it is natural to say that successful completion or scoring high in OET means getting recognition. That too from the organizations worldwide. For this very reason, OET is beneficial for healthcare workers from non-English speaking countries. It is important for different healthcare professionals such as nurses, pharmacists, doctors and physiotherapists. Thus getting through the OET exam is highly necessary.

OET uses real workplace scenarios that the candidates will come across their workplace in the English speaking countries. Professionals who are having healthcare background will find it familiar to them and passing the OET test will be easy for them. Thus OET is the one that is much sought after among all kinds of healthcare professionals. Casper Academy is providing best coaching for IELTS, OET , German Language, Communicative English and more. With more than two decades in the field, Casper Academy of Excellence is the leading IELTS coaching centre in Kerala.
